description: This file contains the implementation of the Filter controller class within the OpenCart admin catalog module. It provides methods for listing, viewing, creating, editing, and saving filter entities, including handling request data, permissions, and rendering templates.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class for managing product filters within the OpenCart admin catalog section, including list, form, and save operations.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class for managing product filters within the OpenCart admin catalog section, including list, form, save, delete, and autocomplete operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the filter listing page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of filters with applied pagination and sorting, typically used via AJAX.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for displaying the list of filters based on current filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a filter, pre-filled with existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of filter data submitted via POST, including permission checks and validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected filters after permission check, received via POST.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides JSON data for filter name autocompletion in the admin interface.
